name: Pipeliners - Sitemap URL Check 2026-10-13
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-10-13

# Summary
A live check of every URL in the Pipeliners sitemap on Oct 13, 2026 (`live-sitemap-url-checks.tsv`, with the fetched `sitemap.xml`).

# Key findings
- 109 sitemap URLs checked.
- All 109 returned HTTP 200, were indexable and carried a self-referencing canonical.
- Compared with the Sep 28 checkup (116 URLs and 4 noindexed URLs in the sitemap), the sitemap was smaller and clean.
